responsibility: Implements the name interning table used by GNU Modula-2 boot code, storing unique strings in a binary tree and assigning each one a stable integer key that can be converted back to a C string through an Indexing-based reverse map. It owns key creation, key lookup, reverse lookup, case-insensitive comparison, output of interned names, and character-level access to keyed strings, making it the canonical string-to-name-key subsystem rather than a general symbol table.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the GNameKey pair: it builds and searches the binary-tree intern table, assigns numeric keys, maintains the reverse Indexing map, and implements case-insensitive comparison and key output, whereas GNameKey.h only declares the name-key API and types.
